# You do not charge what you think you charge.

> Work out your real labor burden, your overhead rate on direct cost, and the hourly rate a trade job has to be sold at — from your own payroll, vehicles, office and materials. Free, private, and it fills in the burden and overhead fields on every bid calculator here.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
